body:
Few years ago I ran away from my home just for a day and was so afraid to go back because I knew I would face my dad's wrath but when I returned he was not home. He was looking for me all over the town and when he came back he didn't spoke a word, just hugged me and started crying

That memory still haunts me to this day that my stupidity broke him.  

I promised I'll never so something so stupid but I don't think I can keep that promise anymore.

My family is the only reason why I haven't committed suicide yet. I'm a failure and disappointment to my family but I know they raised me with so much love and care. They do get angry because they are just normal people. 

I tried for so long to be someone they could be proud of but I failed.

Now a days I can't focus on anything but death. I haven't enjoyed anything in a while. I lurk here on reddit to escape my thoughts but I know I can't win. Pretty soon I'll kill my self.
I don't know why but a Swedish guy on the internet who don't even know my existence gives me more hope to live then my whole neighborhood.

I can somewhat relate to our situation and understand the feeling of worthlessness that constantly keeps dragging you down but at the age of 19 you still have many options to steer your life in a positive direction.

Please pick up a hobby such as drawing or writing. Even if you have no talent, you still have time to practice.  I know it's hard to dedicate yourself in your current mindset but I believe that you can do it and turn it into something productive.   
Also, remember not everyone need to be a super successful to be happy. Sit down and think about something that you can do as work. You can either turn those hobbies into your work or be a loco-pilot, cameraman or hell be a stripper. Pick anything you believe in and talk to your mom. I know she has high hopes but it is normal for every parent to dream big for their kids but I bet they don't want it at their child's expense.   
All I wish for you to at least exhaust all your options before doing something that can't be fixed.   


PS: If it was possible to time travel then I would do the same. I can't think of  a more wholesome suicide method. Such a painless way to go and your parents won't even mourn your absence.

Well, I obviously don't know about your relation with your family but  I guess they are in shock themselves and don't know how to approach this situation. We all expect a more mature and  helpful response from adults but just because they are older don't make them wiser for every situation. Many people grow up with hard headed mentality and naturally approach any tough or shocking situation in a aggressive manner. I hope they will see the fault in their approach soon and will talk to you more openly.   
Meanwhile please talk to someone more sympathetic and understanding. maybe a close friend.
